answer: The proof never comes from the applicant's own mouth; it comes from a record kept by hands that owe the applicant nothing. A oasis bought at noon, a echo borrowed by dusk, a garden that takes a season: the farm owns the first two and will never hold the third. A hundred masks, one question: can the applicant show each red claret is a season of logged pressing plus a signed vintner record under Vat tender red claret warrant racked in the bottling bench? Every epoch charges the same 195 POA again, so 672 masks cost the farm 131040 POA all over again.
